description: This file defines an interface 'MappingOutcome' and associated classes/interfaces for representing the result of message mapping operations in a messaging service. It includes methods for creating different outcome types (mapped, dropped, error), as well as a visitor pattern for processing these outcomes.

classes.name: MappingOutcome
classes.description: Interface representing the outcome of message mapping, supporting different types such as mapped, dropped, or error outcomes, with visitor pattern support.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.Visitor
classes.description: Visitor interface for processing different outcome types.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.VisitorBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing a visitor with custom behavior.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.OnError
classes.description: Functional interface for handling error outcomes.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Allows a visitor to evaluate this outcome.

methods.name: mapped
methods.description: Factory method to create a mapped outcome.

methods.name: dropped
methods.description: Factory method to create a dropped message outcome.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Factory method to create an error outcome.

methods.name: newVisitorBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new visitor builder for processing outcomes.
